# validate/missing_auth — spec that references a nonexistent state field
# produces an error-severity diagnostic on stdout and exits 1.

! exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_stdout.txt

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"

state:
  fields:
    url:
      type: url
      default: "http://localhost:9999"

defaults:
  base_url: {ref: state.url}

auth:
  bearer:
    token: {ref: state.missing_field}

requests:
  - method: GET
    path: /events

response:
  decode: json
  events_at: response.body.events

pagination:
  none: {}

progress:
  latest_event_timestamp:
    event_time:
      path: timestamp
    initial:
      lookback: "1h"

error:
  mode: standard
-- want_stdout.txt --
auth.bearer.token.ref: error: ref "state.missing_field": state field "missing_field" is not declared in state.fields
